title: [SPEC] Protocol Phi + xHTTP — стандарт взаимодействия агентов флота

1_git_native_handoff_spec.rule: Every handoff strictly via immutable git coordinates (repo_url, branch, commit_sha, tree_sha, manifest_sha256).
1_git_native_handoff_spec.zero_trust_env: Receiving side spins up clean ephemeral sandbox from scratch; foreign or ambient workspace reuse forbidden.
1_git_native_handoff_spec.incident_22_10_prevention: Explicit check: mismatch in remote origin or commit SHA triggers WORKSPACE_CONTAMINATED abort.

2_protocol_phi_and_xhttp_suite.identity_and_mandates: DKIM for agents via goDNS / DNS TXT trust anchor (_mandate.<agent>.hackt.com) + Ed25519 hackt-mandate.
2_protocol_phi_and_xhttp_suite.x401_multipass: Mutual challenge/response authentication handshake with cryptographic proof-of-possession.
2_protocol_phi_and_xhttp_suite.x402_budget_guard: Enforcement of wall-clock limit (90m) and weekly task cap (50) to prevent token drain.
2_protocol_phi_and_xhttp_suite.x420_backpressure: Patience envelope for queue ETA, slot saturation, and FSCK_OFF backpressure handling.
2_protocol_phi_and_xhttp_suite.receipts_standard: Machine-readable sealed JSON envelopes in comments (<!-- phi-receipt:... -->) instead of ad-hoc markdown.

3_linear_git_and_qa_verdicts_mapping.linear_issue_mapping: Issue ID -> correlation_id; state machine transitions mapped to protocol intents.
3_linear_git_and_qa_verdicts_mapping.git_branch_mapping: gitBranchName strictly bound to handoff git.branch.
3_linear_git_and_qa_verdicts_mapping.qa_verdict_mapping: Signed QA receipts (PASS / REWORK) with exact checks matrix and hash proofs.
3_linear_git_and_qa_verdicts_mapping.strict_assignee_discipline: No unassigned active tasks ('Мяч всегда в руках').
3_linear_git_and_qa_verdicts_mapping.two_tier_governance: Sub-issues autonomously merged/Done by QA; Project Release gates escalated to Pavel Cherkashin in 1-tap.

test_results.coverage: GitCoordinates, ProtocolPhiEnvelope, ProtocolPhiReceipt, WorkspaceContaminationDetector, PeerReviewBoundary, TwoTierGovernance, Ed25519SignatureVerification, TruncatedSignatureRejection
